Welcome to the official YouTube channel of Robert Gordon University (RGU) in Aberdeen, Scotland.

Our range of degree courses include online degrees as well as traditional taught courses in subjects as diverse as art and design, management and engineering.

We are one of the top 10 universities in the UK for student satisfaction (National Student Survey 2022). 

Find out more on our website www.rgu.ac.uk
